During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''governor''' ruled over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Speco]]. However, it was said that the [[Governor/Legends|governor's]] consort, the former [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] Mistress [[Miaxi]], actually ran the [[Speco system/Legends|system]] by using her charms on the enthralled governor.
